author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at quite the hypocrisy from the big AI companies. Accusations of "distillation" have been thrown out where some of the largest companies who have been using our information without our consent have now had their data stolen by companies on the other side of the planet. How does this happen? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Rules For Thee, Not For Me...
